title: One-coordinate correlated pair law
statement: For every correlation parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the law of the pair of one-coordinate cube points, transported to pairs of signs by the natural coordinate identification, equals the law obtained by choosing the first sign uniformly and then retaining it with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ or flipping it otherwise.
